column1: Status: potentially eligible only. This list shows properties that may be eligible for relief based on rateable value and property type. It does not show who pays business rates or who receives relief. Check eligibility with the billing authority before contacting a business.

Use is limited to non-domestic rating purposes and onward disclosure is restricted. Do not distribute: this file is for authorised users only. It may contain personal data (sole traders and home addresses). Do not share it further until the VO has confirmed the use is within its licence and data protection advice has been taken.
